```markdown:content/en/homepage/opener.md
We are a **brand-new lab** at the [University of Pennsylvania](https://www.upenn.edu), starting in **July 2025**, affiliated with the [Department of Cancer Biology](https://www.upenn.edu/cancer-biology) and the [Center for Cellular Immunotherapies](https://www.med.upenn.edu/cci/).

### Our Mission
{{< icon-section icon="mission-icon.svg" >}}
Our mission is to **understand and engineer the genetic machinery of immune cells**, with the ultimate goal of improving cellular immunotherapies for cancer and other diseases.

### Research Areas
{{< icon-section icon="research-icon.svg" >}}
We focus on three complementary areas:

- **Engineering Therapeutic Receptors**  
  Designing new synthetic receptors to enhance immune cell recognition and targeting

- **Rewiring Cell Signaling**  
  Modifying intracellular pathways to improve immune cell function and persistence

- **Controlling Cell States**  
  Building genetic circuits to direct immune cell differentiation and behavior

### Our Approach
{{< icon-section icon="approach-icon.svg" >}}
We combine cutting-edge technologies from multiple disciplines:

- **Synthetic Biology & Genomics**  
  Engineering cells using advanced genome editing and gene delivery tools

- **Machine Learning & Computation**  
  Developing models to predict and design protein and genetic elements

- **High-throughput Technologies**  
  Creating new platforms for systematic measurement and engineering of immune cells
```

```css:layouts/partials/custom_head.html
/* CSS Variables */

}
```
